tools.name: search_models
tools.description: Search published AI model releases by name, vendor or family. Needs a query (2+ letters) or a vendor.

tools.name: get_model
tools.description: One published AI model record by slug (from search_models), with release date, regions and official source.

tools.name: list_recent_models
tools.description: AI models released in the last N days (default 30, max 90), newest first.

tools.name: search_laws
tools.description: Search published privacy, cybersecurity and AI laws by name/topic, with optional jurisdiction, category, status filters. Not legal advice.

tools.name: get_law
tools.description: One published law by slug: citation, status, effective date, official source link and provision headings. Not legal advice.

tools.name: upcoming_effective_dates
tools.description: Laws taking effect in the next N days (default 180, max 365), soonest first. Not legal advice.

tools.name: pending_bills
tools.description: Pending privacy/AI bills tracked by LawMarch, with last action and the legislature's page. Not legal advice.

tools.name: search_connectors
tools.description: Search published AI connectors and MCP servers by name or publisher.

tools.name: get_connector
tools.description: One published connector record by slug, with publisher, transport, version and official link.

tools.name: about_marchindex
tools.description: What this server covers, data dates, licences, bulk-download links and usage limits.
